'''Echo Seven''' was the callsign of a [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] patrol for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==History==
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], when acting as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]], was assigned to this patrol to search for signs of life on the planet, Hoth. After reporting to [[Echo Three/Legends|Echo Three]]&mdash;[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;that there was not enough life on the planet to fill a space cruiser, he headed back to the [[Rebel base]].

Han turned in his [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] to the handlers when he returned to the base, completing his portion of the mission. However, upon hearing news of Luke's absence, he again took a tauntaun and went out into the blizzard at night to search for his friend.
